description: The complete URL length covers the total occurrences of the listed distinct URL punctuation symbols.
formula: length_url - nb_dots - nb_hyphens - nb_and - nb_eq - nb_underscore - nb_percent - nb_slash - nb_semicolumn >= 0
explanation: Each counted symbol occupies one character in the complete URL, and the symbol categories are mutually distinct.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of periods in the URL.
explanation: Every period counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of hyphens in the URL.
explanation: Every hyphen counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of ampersands in the URL.
explanation: Every ampersand counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of equals signs in the URL.
explanation: Every equals sign counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of underscores in the URL.
explanation: Every underscore counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of percent signs in the URL.
explanation: Every percent sign counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of forward slashes in the URL.
explanation: Every forward slash counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of semicolons in the URL.
explanation: Every semicolon counted in the URL is one character of the complete URL.

description: The longest raw URL token is at least as long as the average raw URL token length.
explanation: An average of nonempty token lengths cannot exceed their maximum.

description: The average raw URL token length is at least as long as the shortest raw URL token.
explanation: An average of nonempty token lengths cannot be below their minimum.

description: The longest host token is at least as long as the average host token length.
explanation: An average of host token lengths cannot exceed their maximum.

description: The average host token length is at least as long as the shortest host token.
explanation: An average of host token lengths cannot be below their minimum.

description: The longest path token is at least as long as the average path token length.
explanation: An average of path token lengths cannot exceed their maximum, including the defined zero values for empty paths.

description: The average path token length is at least as long as the shortest path token.
explanation: An average of path token lengths cannot be below their minimum, including the defined zero values for empty paths.

description: The complete URL length is at least the number of nonempty raw URL tokens.
explanation: Each nonempty raw token contains at least one character and all such tokens are represented in the complete URL.

description: The total number of hyperlinks and linked resources is at least the number of external CSS links.
explanation: External CSS links are a subset of the extracted linked resources counted among total hyperlinks and linked resources.

description: The longest raw URL token is at least as long as the average host token length.
explanation: Host tokens are included among raw URL tokens, so the maximum over all raw tokens cannot be below the average length of the host-token subset.

description: The longest raw URL token is at least as long as the average path token length.
explanation: Path tokens are included among raw URL tokens, so the raw-token maximum cannot be below the average length of the path-token subset, including the defined empty-path zero.
